description: The panel a signed-out screen needs: sign in, check your inbox, this link expired, a two-factor code. It knows nothing about credentials on purpose; the fields are composed inside it.

brand.description: The brand lock-up above the panel's content. An ArenaAppLogo, in practice.

eyebrow.description: Mono crimson microlabel: the product, not the task.

headingLevel.description: Which rung of the document outline the title takes. Only the element changes: the title's class is the same at every value, so the render is identical and no appearance follows from it. It defaults to `h2` because this title is drawn in the section register rather than the card one, so the outline follows the register the same way every other title on the ladder does. A signed-out screen whose only title is this one says `h1` and gets the page's one heading, which is the case the member exists for. `none` takes the title out of the outline entirely; with no title there is no heading either way.

content.description: The fields, composed from ArenaInput and ArenaButton.

footer.description: Centred muted line below the content: a recovery link, a legal note.
